name: Validation
requirementsDoc: Checks for what people type into forms and what arrives in files and API calls — email, phone in international E.164 format, URL, IBAN, card number, postcode by country, required fields — each answering { valid, reason } so a flow can show why.

functions.jsdoc: Parse a phone number typed any way people type them; defaultCountry (US, GB, IN, …) resolves a local number. undefined when it cannot be a phone number; the result has isValid(), number (E.164), country, formatNational(), formatInternational().
